title: Add Legistar HTTP Client unit tests with mock responses
prompt: Create unit tests in backend/tests/test_legistar.py for LegistarClient in backend/scrapers/legistar.py. Use pytest and mock httpx.AsyncClient responses so no live network calls are made. Test fetch_recent_matters and fetch_upcoming_events, including error handling when the Legistar endpoint returns a 500 error.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] backend/tests/test_legistar.py exists with at least 3 test cases
- [ ] Uses unittest.mock or pytest-mock to mock httpx
- [ ] pytest tests/ passes with 100% success
- [ ] ruff check . passes with 0 errors

title: Add Austin and Seattle municipal presets to backend scrapers
prompt: Expand backend/scrapers/legistar.py and backend/main.py to support Austin (client_name: 'austin', state: 'TX') and Seattle (client_name: 'seattle', state: 'WA') as recognized scraper targets alongside Cleveland. Update /api/scrapers/targets endpoint to return all supported cities.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] /api/scrapers/targets endpoint returns Cleveland, Austin, and Seattle
- [ ] Normalizer correctly formats OCD IDs for all three cities
- [ ] pytest tests/ passes
- [ ] ruff check . passes

title: Implement CSV Export endpoint for municipal dockets
prompt: Add a new endpoint GET /api/bills/export-csv in backend/main.py that streams or returns municipal bills as a downloadable CSV formatted according to Open Civic Data standards. Include columns: ocd_id, jurisdiction_id, file_number, official_title, category, status, introduction_date.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] GET /api/bills/export-csv returns text/csv with proper headers
- [ ] Includes unit test in backend/tests/test_api.py verifying CSV output format
- [ ] pytest tests/ passes
- [ ] ruff check . passes

title: Enhance accessibility and keyboard navigation in CivicCopilotDrawer
prompt: Audit frontend/src/components/CivicCopilotDrawer.tsx for accessibility. Ensure all interactive buttons (close button, prompt pills, send button) have explicit aria-labels, manage focus when drawer opens/closes, and support Escape key to close.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] All buttons have aria-label attributes
- [ ] Escape key listener closes drawer when open
- [ ] bun run lint passes with 0 errors
- [ ] bun run build succeeds

title: Add in-memory TTL caching for Legistar OData requests
prompt: Add an asynchronous in-memory TTL cache utility in backend/scrapers/cache.py (with default 15-minute TTL) and wrap LegistarClient calls so repeated requests for the same municipality within 15 minutes return cached records without querying the external Legistar API.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] backend/scrapers/cache.py created with TTL expiration logic
- [ ] LegistarClient uses cache for fetch_recent_matters
- [ ] Unit test verifies cache hits and cache expiration
- [ ] pytest tests/ and ruff check . pass
